researchConclusion: Mature external standards, professional practices, and platform-native mechanisms cover most generic process needs; Game should profile/route them rather than reimplement them.
engineeringConclusion: No generic production-source clone was found; the material local ownership defect was G0-G8 claiming generic outer-lifecycle authority. It was contracted to a Game-specific commitment/stage projection over ISO/IEC/IEEE 12207:2026 and the external-first routing matrix.
doNotInfer: Repository alignment is not ISO/XAG/WCAG/SLSA/OpenChain compliance or certification.
A platform mechanism listed as PLATFORM_NATIVE is not configured until a real product/study/release path activates it.
Telemetry, experiment uplift, technical quality, provenance, or platform approval do not mint Human experience, Product Value, rights, or product-direction truth.
reopenConditions: An adopted external mechanism materially changes version or semantics.
A real Game consumer demonstrates a necessary invariant that cannot be represented through a profile/adapter.
